candidates.description: Canonical Candidate[] used either as reference family sequences when `profile` is absent or as generated designs to score when `profile` is supplied.

fasta_path.description: Optional FASTA file containing unaligned family sequences for lightweight profile construction.

alignment_path.description: Optional aligned FASTA file. When provided, conserved positions and consensus are computed over alignment columns.

profile.description: Existing family profile evidence, normally compiled from a `profile_source` upstream. When present, candidates are scored against it.

family_id.description: Optional stable identifier for the family or semantic term represented by the profile.

family_label.description: Optional human-readable family or functional label to carry into report artifacts.

min_conservation.description: Column conservation threshold used to report conserved positions and motif windows.

motif_window.description: Maximum window length used to group adjacent conserved positions into motif-like evidence windows.

output_prefix.description: Filesystem-safe prefix for generated profile and summary artifacts.
